repos_data.description: Local-first MCP memory & context-handoff server — capture context in one AI tool, resume it in another. Graceful decay, no cloud.

repo_meta_data.description: One TypeScript interface for 24+ LLM providers — swap providers without rewriting. MCP-native (connect any MCP server), voice (TTS/STT/realtime), RAG, memory, file processors. Production-origin: powers Tara, Yama, and Clairvoyance at Juspay.
